alt: The back face of the 2026 Sydney Marathon finisher medal showing Sydney landmarks including the Opera House and Harbour Bridge — alongside Munich's Allianz Arena diamond-patterned roof.
story: The 2026 Sydney Marathon finisher medal — going to ~40,000 runners — celebrates Sydney's iconic landmarks but accidentally engraved Munich's Allianz Arena instead of Sydney's Allianz Stadium because a designer confused the two Allianz-named venues.
why_funny: Organisers declined to replace the medals and quipped 'We're not going to run from it,' while Munich's Allianz Arena posted: 'Oh wow, we didn't have that on our bingo card!'
